answer: The defence rests on email account age with provider creation record: a mailbox created years ago and used continuously since. Forging 515 of these means building 515 separate aged mailboxes from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The bridge test is the price tag: 515 fakes mean 515 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The trellis signal is visible to every grader, and the cedar ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
